task: Review Earth Cave against remaster-yipe-caves and diagnose missing ambience
identity_to_preserve: Room landmarks and damp lower chambers
Original layouts, collisions, secrets, encounters and rescue locations

findings.observed: UpdateCaveAmbience selects Fire or breeding audio only; Earth falls through to no track.
findings.recommendation: Add an Earth-specific recorded cave loop, with low underground air, distant drips and sparse settling grit. Reuse existing fade, mute, pause/focus and effects-ducking behavior. Select and credit a suitable licensed recording before implementing.

findings.observed: Earth already renders fungus glow, falling drips, ripple rings and faint dust. Sources are sparse and their low opacity is easy to lose at gameplay scale.
findings.recommendation: Use deliberate drip positions near wet rock and puddles, clearer pixel ripples, restrained visible motes near light, and occasional wall grit. Keep density localized and test with default presentation.

findings.observed: Only breeding and volcanic maps select BuildCaveMask; Earth uses the older tile-level visibility and torch cutoff. Fungi use a separate translucent glow rather than the contour-light path.
findings.recommendation: Provide the Earth silhouette and its own light positions to contour lighting. Integrate fungus and lamp sources, preserve closed-door and fog blocking, inspect isolated masks and light-on/off views.

findings.observed: Warm earthen identity and landmarks are useful, but broad mottled wall faces and continuous bright edging read softer and flatter than the approved caves.
findings.recommendation: Keep warm sedimentary rock, roots and fossils; add finer facets and selective layered cuts, varied chipped edges and stronger front-face depth. Anchor detail across matching room overlaps instead of map-local seeds.

findings.observed: The floor relies on brown patches, dither and scattered grit. Ordinary dry Earth terrain selects Grass footsteps; water and stone overrides happen earlier.
findings.recommendation: Add compacted dirt, restrained embedded stones, worn routes and damp silt at puddles. Avoid a dense fractured-slate floor. Choose existing granular recordings for dirt/gravel while preserving water contacts.

findings.observed: Earth creatures retain ordinary tint and contact-shadow strength; breeding and Fire have biome-specific treatment.
findings.recommendation: Evaluate restrained warm-earth tint, material-matched landing dust and modest contact shadows, preserving silhouettes, animations, hover height and battle art.

suggested_order: Ambient audio and visual atmosphere first, then contour lighting, then targeted walls/floor and creature integration.

gameplay_views_reviewed: upper E3 and deep E5 presentation
inspection.capture_note: Retained prior verified captures, not a fresh graphics run. WorldEarth, PixelLighting, WorldRenderer and WorldMonsterAnimation hashes match the snapshot taken immediately after that full run and before the breeding-floor iterations. Later production floor changes are confined to WorldBreeding.
inspection.tests: No fresh tests run for this read-only review. Prior full run passed 2629 checks. Existing Earth tests cover visual atmosphere, not an Earth ambient audio lifecycle.

delivery: Review and recommendations only. No gameplay/rendering/audio code or assets changed; no live adventure navigation or relaunch.
